verdict.rationale: Better Stack's API docs describe only two token tiers — a 'global' token valid across all teams and resources, and a team-scoped Uptime token — which offers coarse scoping but no evidence of fine-grained, per-agent or read/write-limited least-privilege credentials tailored for AI agents. Missing for 10: documented scopes/permissions (read-only, resource-specific), agent-specific credential issuance, expiring/rotatable tokens, and any MCP-server-specific auth scoping despite the product advertising an MCP server for LLM workflows.
